Game Overview

In Fill Up Bucket, the core idea is straightforward: channel your inner artist in "Fill Up Bucket," a charming Gameboy-inspired puzzle game. Use your mouse to skillfully draw paths, guiding flowing liquid into waiting buckets. With nostalgic graphics and clever challenges, embrace the flow, conquer obstacles, and unleash your creativity to complete each level with precision and strategy.
